g.title: fm_communication
g.text: D-Flow FM online: DIMR control, NetCDF field exchange

g.title: dimr_init
g.text: Initialize D-Flow FM first; set D-Waves to mode 1
(via a DIMR startGroup, or a non-blank FlowFile);

g.title: dimr_update
g.text: Schedule the D-Flow FM and D-Waves updates

g.title: wave_init
g.text: read D-Flow FM and SWAN geometry;

g.title: fm_step
g.text: read available wave fields via EC

g.title: fields_in
g.text: Master reads and remaps D-Flow FM fields

g.title: swan
g.text: All D-Waves MPI ranks call swan_lib

g.title: fields_out
g.text: maps and writes wave fields if WriteCOM

g.title: note
g.text: DIMR carries lifecycle and timing, not gridded arrays.
The D-Waves master performs file I/O and remapping; all D-Waves ranks
join each library solve and synchronize before the output is processed.
Align the D-Flow FM com-output and D-Waves update schedules;
the arrows do not prescribe one universal update order.

g.title: diagram_credit
g.text: Created with Copilot from prompts, using existing code as reference.
